global_signals.name: RESET#
global_signals.purpose: PHY hardware reset (active LOW); equivalent to BMCR bit 0.15.

global_signals.name: INT#
global_signals.purpose: Optional open-drain interrupt — Link Status change, AutoNeg Complete, Remote Fault, etc.

global_signals.name: MDC
global_signals.purpose: Shared management clock for all PHYs on the MDIO bus.

global_signals.name: VDD/GND
global_signals.purpose: Power. Clause 22.5: 5 V ±5 % @ ≤ 750 mA; modern silicon uses 3.3 / 2.5 / 1.8 V I/O.

handshake_pairs.name: TX_EN ↔ TX_CLK
handshake_pairs.rule: TX_EN transitions synchronous to TX_CLK; PHY samples TXD on each TX_CLK rising edge.

handshake_pairs.name: RX_DV ↔ RX_CLK
handshake_pairs.rule: RX_DV transitions synchronous to RX_CLK; MAC samples RXD on each RX_CLK rising edge.

handshake_pairs.name: CRS / COL ↔ MAC FSM
handshake_pairs.rule: Asynchronous indications (need not align to TX_CLK / RX_CLK).

handshake_pairs.name: MDIO read TA
handshake_pairs.rule: On a read, STA tri-states first TA bit; PHY drives second TA bit to 0; PHY then drives 16 data bits MSB-first.

handshake_pairs.name: MDIO write TA
handshake_pairs.rule: On a write, STA drives 10 during TA, then 16 data bits MSB-first.

handshake_pairs.name: AutoNeg FLP exchange
handshake_pairs.rule: Each side transmits FLP bursts encoding its Base Page; convergence = three identical Base Pages received with Acknowledge set.

handshake_pairs.name: PAUSE frame
handshake_pairs.rule: Receiver-overflow → send PAUSE with quanta = N; partner stalls TX for N × 512 BT (full-duplex only).

dependency_graph.common_rule: TX path (MII / GMII) is synchronous to TX_CLK or GTX_CLK; RX path is synchronous to RX_CLK; MDC is asynchronous to both. The MAC owns frame assembly + CRC; the PHY owns line coding + clock recovery. MII / GMII do not by themselves contain encoding — the PHY adds 4B/5B / MLT-3 / 8B/10B / PAM5 on the MDI side.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Frame transmission requires: (1) BMSR Link Status (1.2) = 1, (2) AutoNeg Complete (1.5) = 1 if AutoNeg was enabled, (3) for half-duplex: CRS = 0 for ≥ 96 BT. Frame reception requires: (1) RX_DV ↑ with PHY-detected line activity, (2) byte-aligned SFD detection, (3) full FCS-32 validation after RX_DV ↓.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active TX nibble / byte stream
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: TX_EN asserted; TXD carrying preamble / SFD / DA / SA / Type/Length / Payload / Pad / FCS data.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active RX nibble / byte stream
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: RX_DV asserted; RXD carrying the received frame.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Inter-Frame Gap (IFG)
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: TX_EN = 0 and (optionally) RX_DV = 0 for ≥ 96 BT; required between back-to-back frames.

logical_signaling_levels.name: False Carrier
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: RX_DV = 0, RX_ER = 1, RXD = 0x1110 — PHY detected line activity that is not a valid frame.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Carrier Sense (half-duplex)
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: CRS = 1 whenever the medium is non-idle.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Collision (half-duplex)
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: COL = 1 while medium is being driven by another station simultaneously.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Electrical Idle (MDIO)
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: MDIO line at logic-1 (PHY pull-up), no STA driver active.

logical_signaling_levels.name: AutoNeg FLP burst
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Sequence of 17-33 link pulses on the twisted pair encoding the 16-bit Base Page; transmitted before line-coded data signaling begins.

packet_types_summary.count: 10+ canonical EtherTypes; full IEEE EtherType registry has hundreds

ordering_rules.bit_order_within_byte: LSB-first on the MII / GMII wire — first bit transmitted is bit 0 of the octet, except FCS which is processed LSB-first by the CRC engine then appended as 4 octets MSB-byte-first.
ordering_rules.byte_order_within_field: Network byte order (MSB-first / big-endian) for multi-byte protocol fields such as DA, SA, EtherType, VLAN TCI, IPv4 header.
ordering_rules.frame_boundary: TX_EN edges define frame boundaries on the MII; the PHY emits PMD-specific start-of-stream + end-of-stream delimiters on the MDI (e.g. /J/K/ start + /T/R/ end for 100BASE-X).
ordering_rules.mdio_bit_order: MSB-first for PHYAD, REGAD, DATA — first bit on the wire is the MSB.
